question: Should `/v1/chat/completions` keep `tool_calls` limited to caller-supplied client tools, or expose redacted internal OpenClaw tool telemetry through a new explicit mode?
rationale: Current source and docs define a client-tool contract, while exposing internal tool arguments would change the Gateway trust boundary and can reveal sensitive operator context.

options.title: Keep Client-Tool Contract
options.body: Leave `tool_calls` limited to caller-supplied HTTP tools and route internal tool visibility to existing or improved diagnostic surfaces.

options.title: Design Explicit Telemetry Mode
options.body: Add a new opt-in, redacted internal-tool telemetry surface only after maintainer security review defines scopes, redaction, and compatibility behavior.

options.title: Request Concrete Repro First
options.body: Ask for a qwen request/response and session artifact before deciding whether this is provider parsing trouble rather than an API feature request.

recommendation.title: Keep Client-Tool Contract
recommendation.body: Leave `tool_calls` limited to caller-supplied HTTP tools and route internal tool visibility to existing or improved diagnostic surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available decision owner from the likely owners because the unresolved question is Gateway API/security direction and steipete has follow-up work on this contract.
